## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `375a0618167b0ab1f4651529d87cfe0aa7542ff1`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + .claude/agents/os-dev.md, scripts/pm/with-fleet.sh, scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md

### ① Derived judgments
Diff read against merge base 65b49208 (main a0aa8a1f touched neither file): +18/−18, 245/188 lines kept.
- Old L110+L111: SURVIVES at L110 「trigger 会话无仓库授权只读,`create_session` 带 `source_url` 可推送」.
- Old L112+L113: SURVIVES at L111 (lane leads the form); 「trigger 流不可指模型」 SURVIVES at L124.
- Old L114+L116 (停摆等 poke, 两个终点): SURVIVES at L112 「合法终点仅推送加终报、硬阻塞详报」; poke remedy = L117's recipe beside L116's stall read.
- Old L115 「⛔ 不为提问或中报结束回合」: no literal home on main (grep: 0). SURVIVES in substance: L112's 「仅」 closes the list (a question or mid-report is neither endpoint), L113 keeps the open_questions/fork routing, and os-dev.md L336 「报告只有两种」 + L344 「终消息只能是报告 JSON 或 blocked 报告」 bind the dev to the same set (true in substance, not in those words).
- Old L118: SURVIVES at L113. Old L120+L121: SURVIVES at L116. L122/L125: wording only.
- Old L126+L127 「跨账号接班活性只认 GitHub 产出读数」: SURVIVES widened at L121; its own `not found` clause scopes it to unseen sessions, no clash with L116's `get_session` read.
- Exec-duties L146+L147: the rule SURVIVES at L146; the gloss 「(安装 + 拉缓存)」 is LOST, no other home (grep 固定开销: 0), no ≤120-byte spelling restores it — disclosed narrowing, not must-fix.
- New ① holds (card 1; wording, see ④). ② holds (card 2; both evidence comments). ③ holds (card 3). ④ holds (card 6 visibility half). ⑤ holds (card 4; 6464903026 「no workflow run … no github-actions suite」, both remedies kept). ⑥ holds (card 5). 「实测六异」 = the card's 「six points, each measured」; no line teaches a capability the platform lacks. Archive half: exec-duties L148.
- Heading reader: `git grep -n 四课 origin/main` → only the heading itself.

### ② Semver level
None: `.claude/**` only, no package publishes it; `skip-changeset` on the PR, Check Changeset success; `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags
- Open question: A, agreed — 「仅」 makes the endpoints a closed list, L113 keeps the routing, os-dev.md L336/L344 carry the same set; B spends a ceiling raise on restated text.
- net +8 → 0: accepted (headroom 0). Parenthetical: accepted as disclosed. Numbering ④/⑥ vs card 6/5: accepted. Re-checks only on ①/⑤: accepted, the card names exactly three. Trailers: AGENTS.md L444 pair on 593fa8ec; bare merge commit moot under squash. Extra gates / hypotheses: noted.
- Bytes via `len(line.encode())`: widest new line 120 (runbook L110/L123/L126/L127, exec-duties L146); file-wide max 120 in both.
- Head CI at read: 45 check-runs, 23 success, 22 skipped, 0 failed / in progress.

### ④ Design judgment
Scenario: a seat reading 五 pushes the pointer first (①), knows the tier inherits (②), passes no `--session` (③), reads no death in its unseen session (④, L121), plans the re-push or late PR-open (⑤), knows REWORK (⑥) and archive (L148). Lesson ③ vs headers: with-fleet.sh 「dispatch only when the cloud discriminator, the seat's session (read from CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID) and a live relay all hold」 + dispatch.mjs condition ②: the line names one of three conditions and the right prohibition — understated, not contradicted. Self-contained: no issue numbers in added lines. No anchor checker reads 「云卡五课」.
must-fix: runbook L123 「先推同名指针分支到 `origin/main`」 parses as a push destination — the one wrong reading on the line that prevents the three start failures. Replace L123 with (120 bytes; house style of old L112 「(= 认领分支)」):
「- 先推同名指针分支(= `origin/main`),⛔ 不提交其上;复核 `get_session`→`branch`、`ls-remote --heads`。」
Paid in place: same line, same width.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27214-desktop-cloud-lesson`
Reviewed-by: `session_017xRBcUi2qhP1eKRbZJ1Ze1`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Seat note: review run by an isolated at-tier reviewer agent, adopted by the seat (`domain:skills#1`) at 2026-10-28T16:15Z; the patch round goes back to the original dev on the same branch and claim; a delta review of the fixing commit follows.

## 维护者速读(席位终稿,钉 head `3809c88b`)

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 运行细则的云卡一节由「四课」变「五课」,新增「五、桌面 `start_session`(`target: cloud`)」六条实测差异(基底指针分支、模型继承发起席位、中继自选、席位看不见会话、PR 后推送不触发 CI、交回只经 GitHub);执行职责云卡行加一条指针,并写明桌面起的云会话归档落维护者。
- 为什么改:首两张桌面起的云卡在这六处踩坑(三次开局即死、档位跑错、最终 head 没进 CI),旧文本只描述 API 路径,席位照做会重犯。
- 风险与回滚:纯协议文本,两文件行数不变(245 / 188,均顶格),每行 ≤120 字节,无脚本、无门禁、无标签;风险是压缩后一条旧规则读得更省略(逐行对照见 PR 正文表格与契约复核 ①);回滚 = revert。
- 先看:`dispatch-runbook.md` L122–L127(新五课)与 L110–L121(付账压缩的旧四课);`execution-duties.md` L146、L148。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 两文件各印 `245 lines (ceiling 245; headroom 0)` 与 `188 lines (ceiling 188; headroom 0)`;`sed -n 122,127p .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` 看到 ①–⑥。
- 需要你做的:无。Tier S(`.claude/**`):达档契约复核 PASS 在案,席位落地(ready + auto-merge)。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。砍点逐条核幸存(复核 ①):唯一字面丢失的是「⛔ 不为提问或中报结束回合」,其实质由同节「合法终点仅…」的闭合列表与 os-dev.md 干净收尾 ④ 承载;「(安装 + 拉缓存)」注释为已申报收窄。首版 L123 「推…到 `origin/main`」读作推送目的地,复核 FAIL 后同分支一轮补丁改为「(= `origin/main`)」,delta PASS。

## 席位核对

- 形态:draft PR,目标 `main`,正文首行 `Fixes #27214`,`Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` 在正文;`skip-changeset`(`.claude/**` 无包发布);assignee `sunhaolin`;两文件 +18/−18,三个 commit(`593fa8ec` 任务、`375a0618` 合 main、`3809c88b` 补丁)。
- 前提实测:`origin/main` 上旧节「云卡(`mode:cloud`)四课」在 L108;`git grep 四课 origin/main` 只命中该标题本身,无脚本或他文锚定;PR #27292(席位 2)已在分支切出前落地,无需调和。
- 门禁 check-runs(钉 head `3809c88b`,本席读数时刻见戳):38 check-runs: success 14, skipped 18, in_progress 6; not yet green: Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Type Check · consumer gates
- 接受的偏差:① 卡上「净 +8 行」被行棘轮(两文件余量 0)取代为净 0,已申报;② 编号与卡不同(卡 6 → ④,卡 5 → ⑥),归档半边落 execution-duties L148;③ 只有 ①⑤ 带复核命令(卡只点名三条);④ dev 两次 worktree 重建与 `check:doc-formula-expressions` 先 exit 3 后建包 exit 0,皆如实记录。
- 范围外去向:中继自选的完整条件住 `with-fleet.sh` / `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` 头注,课文只写席位不得传的参数 —— Acceptance notes,不立卡。
- 落地条款:Tier S,落地前检 = `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27308` + 全 check 绿或预期 skip;过则中继 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`。契约复核记录:FAIL 6474334819(head `375a0618`)→ delta PASS 6474438296(head `3809c88b`)。
